name: 女童立体泡泡印花短袖针织衫款
description: 柔软针织亲肤透气，立体泡泡印花减龄吸睛，日常外穿百搭

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, alternating soft blush #FDEFF2, pale mint #EAF3EF, warm cream #F5EFE6 and mist-blue #E9F1F8 panels for info and scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, no hard cutout shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper backdrops and light woven bedding surfaces, soft and uncluttered
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line garment icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set, garment always fully steamed and wrinkle-free
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet soft childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cherry-pink #F5AEBE, clean white #FFFFFF, mist-blue #DCE9F2 and charcoal text #3A3A3C; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line garment icon style; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, garment laid perfectly smooth and centered, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, garment fills the frame edge to edge within the 60-70% occupancy
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a child's short-sleeve crew-neck knit tee. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, garment perfectly steamed and centered, full silhouette visible with sleeves naturally spread. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond the garment margin. Negative: no child model, no hanger, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no wrinkles, no cut-off sleeves or hem.

shots.intent: 一秒传递立体印花与甜系外穿的核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, garment on a child-size mannequin form shown from the neck down, positioned left of center
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light with gentle accent glow on the chest print, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 为卧室床头场景首图，女童穿粉色短袖针织衫配草莓印花半裙，文案主打甜系外穿；屏2 为胸前立体泡泡印花中景与外出逛街/聚会/日常休闲三场景卖点；屏3 为白色网格背景平铺与胸口印花放大，标注透气/柔软/工艺类标签；屏4 为产品信息区（品名套头针织衫、颜色蓝粉灰、尺码 90-140、针织面料）与四项指数条及尺码表格；屏5 为尺码表延续与多色可选三色（灰粉蓝）正/侧/背展示；屏6-7 为圆领、印花、袖口螺纹收口细节微距；屏8-9 为卧室与床头多角度模特展示。品类判定依据：尺码为身高段 90-140 的童装段位、成衣为短袖套头针织衫、文案场景为逛街/聚会/日常外穿（非睡衣家居诉求），故判为「母婴/童装」外穿而非「内衣家居服/儿童内衣」；源夹名「童装」与判定一致，但页内自称「毛衣/精品毛衣」与实拍短袖针织 T 恤形态不符，leaf 依实拍判为女童圆领短袖针织衫。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与领标、原文案原句、具体尺码表数值（改为空白表格与 {callout} 占位）、四项指数条的勾选结论、童模面容与身份（源图已打码，模版只允许颈部以下或背影式 generic child model）、胸口具体字母印花图案（仅保留「胸口印花位」结构描述，图案交给 {product_identity_lock}）、珍珠手链等配饰单品身份。
